issue.title: app._agents_local_visible is write-only dead state that keeps removed rows after a clan x
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-18d.7.1 (epic sase-18d.7, "Complete Agents-tab x end-to-end regression coverage") as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #2. The sase-18d.7 land agent triaged it at master 02c4b029a.

ROOT CAUSE: `app._agents_local_visible` is written in three places and never read in production:
- src/sase/ace/tui/actions/_state_init_agents.py:45 (init)
- src/sase/ace/tui/actions/agents/_fleet_projection.py:140, in `_sync_agents_local_source_from_current`, which mirrors it from `self._agents`
- src/sase/ace/tui/actions/agents/_loading_apply.py:431, from `boundary.fold.local_visible_agents`
The TYPE_CHECKING declaration is at _fleet_projection.py:77. `grep -rn _agents_local_visible src` finds no reader. After a clan kill, `_sync_agents_local_source_from_current` mirrors it from `_agents` before `_refilter_agents` rebuilds `_agents`, so it keeps removed rows. The sase-18d.7 pilot harness (tests/ace/tui/_agents_x_pilot_helpers.py) deliberately does not assert on it. The mirror predates sase-18d (2da11eb28, 2026-09-10), so it was not caused by that epic.

FIX: delete the attribute and its three writes plus the TYPE_CHECKING declaration. Then update the test fakes that set it: tests/test_agents_tab_removal_tombstones.py, tests/test_agents_tab_finalize_plan_fleet.py (drop the line-224 assertion or retarget it at a real consumer), tests/ace/tui/test_agents_fleet_refresh_laziness.py, tests/ace/tui/test_agents_panel_focus_follows_selection.py, tests/ace/tui/bench_tui_jk_fleet.py, and tests/perf/test_agents_display_rebuild_guard.py. Keep `PreparedFold.local_visible_agents` if other code still reads it. If a real reader is wanted instead, re-sync the attribute after `_refilter_agents`.

task_type_fields.impact: No user-visible effect today. It is a trap: any future reader would see removed rows come back after x.
task_type_fields.repro: grep -rn _agents_local_visible src shows only writes (_state_init_agents.py:45, _fleet_projection.py:140, _loading_apply.py:431). In the sase-18d.7.1 pilot, after clan x the attribute still holds the removed clan members because it mirrors _agents before _refilter_agents runs.

payload.description: Parent kill/dismiss epic whose pilot harness exposed the stale mirror
